prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one transparent background architecture layer, PH-20, for the Mass Effect Armax fighting-game project.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: our existing generated Port Hanshan exterior prototype, not a claim of exact canonical reconstruction.
Primary request: extract the architecture into one standalone alpha layer through a faithful image edit. Keep the source's full wide 16:9 canvas, camera, scale, perspective, silhouette positions and composition. The broad stacked buildings at left, the tall roofed tower at right, the central terraces, antennae, snow resting on roofs, narrow warm window lights and cool grey materials must remain where they are in image 1. Keep the buildings continuing naturally to the bottom edge exactly as framed.
Remove only the cloudy sky, airborne falling snow streaks, fog and atmospheric background visible between or above building silhouettes; those removed areas must be genuinely transparent. Preserve solid snow accumulated on the architecture as part of the building material. Reconstruct surfaces previously obscured by falling snow only from their existing panel patterns, without adding new architectural features.
Output one architecture layer only. No character, no foreground fighting floor, no interior room, no new building, no added signage, no HUD, no caption, no painted checkerboard, no opaque backdrop. Do not zoom, recenter, mirror, reshape the buildings, or turn the scene into a square icon. Preserve the full source framing and use real alpha transparency.
